description:
## Why

Operators migrating off Exchange/Outlook have mailbox archives in .pst format. Providing a PST import path lets them bring historical mail into stoa without manual conversion steps. Combined with the Maildir backend (stoa-hgfmg), the full migration path is: PST → stoa ingest → Maildir → notmuch index.

## What

A CLI subcommand: `stoa-mail import-pst <file.pst> [--group <newsgroup>] [--account <account-id>]`

For each message in the PST:
1. Extract raw RFC 5322 message bytes via libpst/readpst
2. Synthesize missing NNTP headers if absent (Newsgroups from --group flag or PST folder name, Message-ID if missing)
3. Inject into stoa via the normal POST ingest pipeline (same path as NNTP POST — dedup, CID assignment, overview backfill, group log entry)
4. Report progress and skipped duplicates (by Message-ID)

PST folder hierarchy maps to newsgroup names: PST folder `Inbox/Project-X` → newsgroup `imported.inbox.project-x` (configurable prefix).

## Implementation

No mature Rust PST library exists. Two options:

**Option A — readpst subprocess:** Shell out to `readpst -o <tmpdir> -r <file.pst>` to convert to Maildir, then walk the Maildir and ingest each .eml. Adds readpst (from pst-utils) as a runtime dependency for this subcommand only. Simple; no FFI.

**Option B — libpst FFI:** Direct C FFI to libpst. Faster, no temp directory, but requires libpst-dev at build time and unsafe FFI boundary.

Start with Option A. Gate behind a pst-import Cargo feature.

## Acceptance

- stoa-mail import-pst ingests all messages from a PST file
- Duplicate messages (same Message-ID already in store) are skipped without error
- PST folder → newsgroup mapping is configurable
- Progress reported to stdout (count ingested, count skipped, count errored)
- Tested against a real PST file (sample PSTs available from the libpst test suite)
notes: Sample PST files for testing: libpst ships test fixtures in its test suite. The Microsoft MS-PST spec is public on the Open Specifications site if Option B (FFI) is ever pursued.
title: PST import: ingest Outlook .pst archives into stoa
